scenes.spoken_text: Coordinate desk surface, storage and cable routes around usable space, actual products, movement and service access.
scenes.caption: Coordinate desk surface, storage and cable routes around usable space, actual products, movement and service access.

scenes.spoken_text: Exercise only: a 1400 mm under-desk envelope with storage occupying 400 mm leaves 1400 − 400 = 1000 mm. This is geometric remainder, not proof of comfort or accessibility. Define measurement boundaries and check frame, base, chair and user movement.
scenes.caption: 1000 mm is the geometric remainder only.

scenes.spoken_text: Draw drawers open with the chair in use. Define contents, access and product-specific stability requirements. Fitting beneath the top does not prove freedom of movement. Test mobile storage in its actual working position, not a convenient display position.
scenes.caption: Review storage with the chair and open drawers.

scenes.spoken_text: List devices, cable entries, supports and access covers. For moving or height-adjustable desks, check the documented route at travel limits under system instructions so cables are not pulled or trapped. Furniture details do not authorize electrical cable alterations; specialists review services while furniture provides coordinated routing and access.
scenes.caption: Check the route through its movement states.

scenes.spoken_text: The 1000 mm remainder is correct, yet an open drawer obstructs the chair. Revise storage position and review access and cables, then repeat the task trial. Decision: complete the calculation with a movement check.
scenes.caption: Decision: complete the calculation with a movement check.
